verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents built-in automations such as auto-starting Epics and auto-creating Iterations, so versioning and rolling back those automations is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows version history, review, or rollback for automations. The suggested Doc changes feature and the MCP server's local testing are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
